title: Realizing the AMD Exascale Heterogeneous Processor Vision : Industry Product
problem: AMD's initial Exascale Heterogeneous Processor vision required a fully-integrated APU for HPC, but advanced heterogeneous integration capabilities were not mature enough at Frontier's design time. The challenge is balancing tight CPU-GPU integration with practical manufacturability constraints while supporting exascale and AI workloads.
motivation: Integrated heterogeneous systems are essential for maximizing performance and efficiency in exascale computing and large-language model and generative AI applications.
method: AMD's original vision was to integrate CPU and GPU components onto a single processor for extreme-scale computing. When Frontier was designed, manufacturing capabilities weren't ready for this approach, so AMD separated the CPU and GPU instead. Learning from Frontier, AMD developed advanced packaging technologies and refined strategies for connecting multiple small chips together as one system. The MI300A applies these innovations to achieve the original goal: a processor that integrates CPU and GPU through advanced packaging and chiplet interconnection, enabling extreme-scale scientific computing and AI.
key_novelty: AMD successfully integrated CPU and GPU components onto a single processor using advanced packaging and chiplet techniques (connecting multiple smaller chips together), enabling practical support for extreme-scale computing and AI applications.
contributions: Analysis of why full APU integration was infeasible for Frontier and identification of previous EHP shortcomings
Development of MI300A APU using advanced heterogeneous packaging and chiplet architecture
Demonstration of integrated CPU-GPU design supporting both exascale HPC and large-language model applications
Validation of chiplet strategy for tightly-coupled heterogeneous system integration

metrics.other: architectural evolution from Frontier to MI300A

limitations: Limitations and future directions not discussed in abstract.
primary_theme: Heterogeneous APU integration for exascale and AI computing
